title: The First {Dy4} Single-Molecule Magnet with a Toroidal Magnetic Moment in the Ground State

material_class.structural_family: centrosymmetric planar {Dy4} parallelogram with two μ3-OH, two μ-OH, and four μ-bpt bridges; eight-coordinate N4O4 square-antiprismatic Dy sites

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (0.043 g, 0.1 mmol), 2,2'-bptH (0.023 g, 0.1 mmol), and triethylamine (0.030 g, 0.3 mmol) in ethanol was sealed in a 15 mL Teflon-lined reactor, heated at 160 °C for 3 days, and cooled to room temperature at 5 °C h−1. Colorless transparent crystals were collected manually. The main text only states that colorless brick crystals were obtained from solvothermal reaction of Dy(NO3)3·5H2O with 2,2-bptH in the presence of triethylamine, without quantities.
synthesis.temperature: 160 °C, then cooled to room temperature at 5 °C h−1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals formed during cooling and were collected manually; colorless transparent (main text: colorless brick) crystals.

properties.summary: Tetranuclear Dy SMM with a nonmagnetic ground exchange state corresponding to a toroidal arrangement of local Dy(III) moments. χMT falls from 56.4 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K to 20.5 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K. Magnetization reaches 19.2 μB near 15 kOe at 2.0 K and then rises slowly. Ac susceptibility shows slow relaxation; Arrhenius analysis of the high-temperature regime gives Δeff/kB = 80(3) K and τ0 = 5.75×10−6 s, with quantum tunneling at lower temperature. Ab initio CASSCF finds strongly axial ground Kramers doublets (gz ≈ 19.90 and 19.89).

measurements.name: effective energy barrier Δeff/kB
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of high-temperature relaxation times; polycrystalline sample, 0 Oe dc, 5 Oe ac, frequencies 1–1500 Hz

measurements.name: τ0
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius prefactor from the high-temperature regime
